_readme: Pimcore pack knowledge. Structural conventions (bundles, composer.json, src/, vendor/pimcore, DI decoration, var/classes definitions) are STABLE and live in pack.json as_source.
The two lists below are SEED, not verified facts: assembled from general Pimcore/Symfony knowledge. Re-verify per engagement against pimcore.com/docs and the installed bundle versions.

SCOPE WARNING that applies to both lists: Pimcore is primarily PIM/MDM + DAM + CMS; commerce is the OPTIONAL E-Commerce Framework bundle, which ships building blocks and no storefront. Neither list implies a shipped shop API or a shipped set of editorial components.

target_api_endpoint_families: Data Hub GraphQL operation names are GENERATED from the Data Object class names and from the Data Hub configuration, so the entries below are PATTERNS with <ClassName> placeholders, not fixed endpoints. The project's Data Hub configuration is the only authoritative source; no integration contract can be written without it.

target_content_component_types lists Document types, Document editables and the brick mechanism. Pimcore ships the MECHANISMS and the admin UI, not a library of ready-made editorial components - every area brick in a project is custom-built. See pack.json as_target.snippets.content_model_notes.
target_api_endpoint_families: Data Hub GraphQL endpoint: POST /pimcore-graphql-webservices/<configuration> with an API key (verify exact path and auth scheme per version)
graphql query: get<ClassName>(id | fullpath) - generated per Data Object class enabled in the Data Hub configuration
graphql query: get<ClassName>Listing(ids, filter, sortBy, first, after) - generated listing per Data Object class
graphql query: getAsset(id | fullpath) and getAssetListing
graphql query: getAssetFolder and getAssetFolderListing
graphql query: getDocumentPage, getDocumentSnippet, getDocumentLink and getDocumentFolder (verify which document types the version exposes)
graphql query: getDocumentListing / document tree traversal (verify)
graphql mutation: create<ClassName>, update<ClassName>, delete<ClassName> - only when mutations are enabled in the Data Hub configuration
graphql mutation: createAsset, updateAsset, deleteAsset, createAssetFolder (verify)
graphql: element relation resolution and localized field arguments (language parameter on every localized field)
graphql: classification store and object brick / field collection sub-selections inside a class query (verify field naming)
Simple REST adapter: GET /pimcore-datahub-webservices/simplerest/<configuration>/tree-items (verify bundle name and path)
Simple REST adapter: GET /pimcore-datahub-webservices/simplerest/<configuration>/search (Elasticsearch-backed, read-only - verify)
Simple REST adapter: GET /pimcore-datahub-webservices/simplerest/<configuration>/get-element (verify)
Studio backend REST API: /pimcore-studio/api/* (accompanies the newer admin UI - verify existence, stability and whether it is intended for integrations for the version in scope)
Legacy Webservice REST API: removed in the Pimcore 10 line (verify the exact release) - an old integration against it has no successor by the same paths

Commerce shopper APIs: NONE shipped - cart, checkout, order and customer endpoints are project-built Symfony controllers over CartManager / CheckoutManager / OrderManager / PricingManager services (verify)
Inbound data: Data Importer bundle configurations (file, HTTP, SQL, SFTP pull) - a scheduled import mechanism, not an HTTP API surface (verify)

Outbound events: PHP-level events only (DataObjectEvents, AssetEvents, DocumentEvents, ecommerce framework events) - no shipped outbound webhook family, so webhooks are project code or a bundle (verify)
Admin/permission surface: Pimcore user, role and workspace permissions govern API access per Data Hub configuration and per element path (verify how the project scopes API keys)
target_content_component_types: Document type: page (the CMS page, bound to a Twig template and a controller)
Document type: snippet (reusable content fragment included into pages)
Document type: link (managed outbound or internal link)
Document type: hardlink (mirrors a document subtree, used for multi-site and multi-language)
Document type: email (transactional email document)
Document type: newsletter (newsletter document with recipient sources)
Document type: folder (structure only)
Document type: printpage / printcontainer (Web-to-Print bundle - verify it is installed)
Area brick (AreabrickInterface class plus Twig view - Pimcore's reusable component type, always custom-built per project)
Editable: areablock (the container editors use to place, sort and configure bricks)
Editable: block (repeatable group of editables inside a template)
Editable: input and textarea (plain text)
Editable: wysiwyg (rich text)
Editable: image (asset reference with thumbnail configuration and hotspots/markers)
Editable: video and audio (asset or external provider reference)
Editable: pdf (asset reference with page rendering)
Editable: link (internal element or external URL)
Editable: select, multiselect, checkbox, numeric, date (configuration-style editables)
Editable: table (tabular content)
Editable: relation and relations (references to Data Objects, Assets or Documents - the bridge from page to PIM content)
Editable: embed / renderlet (embed external content or render an element through a controller)
Editable: scheduledblock (time-scheduled content variants)
Editable: snippet (include a snippet document)
Data Object content carriers: localized fields, field collections, object bricks, classification store (PIM/product content, not page layout)
Thumbnail and video-thumbnail configuration (the rendering contract for every image and video component)

_stamp.source: seed from general platform knowledge, to be verified
